## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Use fictional data and dedicated test accounts.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials, real mailbox data, local paths or signing material are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; behavior changes have appropriate coverage.
- [ ] Sending and model requests remain explicit user actions.
- [ ] Documentation and release limitations reflect the implementation.
